review: Actual closed short six-sided lantern, perforated facets and curved roof replace the tall sparse paper lamp.
Rejected appearance: too many isolated flat discs in the rail finial and an overly opaque black pierced lamp plate.
Continuous rounded upper bulb and shorter-neck cast finial replace the R05 thin discs. Lamp lattice is more open and material uses the existing real local veranda probe.
Personally inspected full1254, actual native lamp subfrustum and true low side camera. Retained fixture design for R07; overall scene still visibly CG.
Common real platform lift .3258m and .64 lower-guard height put the middle post foot at y1111 instead of y1256, while holding every finial seat.
CPU actual triangle contact exposed inherited long-board under-sampling: middle post bottom was48.4mm above the actual board. Candidate repaired before capture.
Adaptive per-triangle longest-edge tessellation closed the post contact but introduced nonconforming edges before curved deformation. It was replaced by shared-index longitudinal swept solids.
Personally inspected full1254, genuine native rail subfrustum and actual low side view. Common raised deck/short guard improves the reference foot/floor placement and remains structurally joined.
Not accepted: R07 close view shows sparse angular leaf relief and the inherited .72m column sleeve is too tall after raising the deck; revised in R08.
